dct_description_sm: Also shows eastern Alabama. Relief shown by hachures. Signed in ink on verso: "W.T. Sherman, Maj. Gen. Map used by General Sherman in the campaign of 1864." Map also signed in ink on verso: "Corse" [i.e., Maj. Gen. John M. Corse]. Includes annotations in pencil.
